name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.312.0 — delegated driver stops on disk: core § Delegated Stops, run.md already-in-worktree skip, fix.md delegated question kinds. 7.311.0 — review driver: the durable-row loss detector matches by runId and drains retarget the stopped/escalate marks — no false 'no longer readable' warning after a stopped-then-recovered review. 7.310.0 — The host names its runner grammar: the grounding contract documents the {file} placeholder in testCommand and typecheckCommand, the optional trunk key, capabilities.failCountPattern and a fail-closed forge (github or none; absent or other means no forge adapter); /spec:init profiles forge, trunk, file placement and failCountPattern; /spec:doctor runs init-gen grammar-check and nudges on an undeclared capabilities.forge. [breaking: a host with no capabilities.forge stops observing CI until /spec:init writes it].
